visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands in a studio setting. (2) A black and white illustration compares skeletons of a chimpanzee, gorilla, and human, with red lines and arrows highlighting jaw differences. (3) A close-up shot shows a patient's open mouth with dental tools examining teeth, followed by a 3D medical animation showing a wisdom tooth growing horizontally under the gums. (4) The man returns to the studio, gesturing with both hands near his face to explain bone structure. He wears a small lapel microphone. (5) A brief animation of Batman in a thinking pose is shown, followed by real footage of a chimpanzee looking contemplative and then another swinging near a wall. (6) An elderly woman in a domestic kitchen dances enthusiastically toward the camera. (7) Back in the studio, a 3D tooth model floats next to the man with text overlays. (8) A young woman in a yellow chair smiles as a dentist in pink scrubs works. (9) Transition to a blue title card for '牙驛通', followed by screen recordings of a digital interface showing dental charts and data tables. (10) Close-ups of hands writing on paper and using a card payment machine. (11) Medical professionals in full blue protective gowns and masks treat an elderly man in a home environment. (12) The man in the studio concludes with open-handed gestures before a final search bar graphic appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male vocal narration begins over a bright, rhythmic electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 kick drum. The speaker maintains a professional but enthusiastic tone with clear articulation. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect occurs during a visual transition. The BGM remains consistent in tempo while the narrator's pitch rises slightly for emphasis on the 'flat face' theory. (3) A sequence of brief 'pop' and 'click' sound effects punctuate the explanation of dental growth. The BGM maintains energy. (4) Narrative shift as the speaker mentions chimpanzees; vocal tone becomes slightly more humorous. Subtle ambient shifts are masked by the high-quality studio mix. (5) Transition sound effects lead into the promotional segment. The BGM remains upbeat. (6) Sound of paper rustling and mechanical clicks sync with the footage of handwriting and card usage. (7) Final segment features the narrator delivering a call to action with high authority and confidence, ending with a clean audio finish.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the biological reason for late wisdom tooth growth (limited jaw space due to human evolution) and use this scientific curiosity to promote '牙驛通' (Dental Bridge), a data-driven home-care dental service platform developed with support from a public innovation project.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly introduces the platform '牙驛通', its mission, and its collaboration with GitHub and Google Colab, including a clear call to action to search for the project.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges science communication with product promotion through high-density editing and a charismatic presenter.
